description: Fades the sound in from silence up to a chosen peak moment and back out to silence - a single dynamic arch pinned at peaktime. No mode digit (unlike most envel operations). Duration static and exact at both probed input durations (2.0 -> 2.0, 1.0 -> 1.0). Shape verified: with peaktime 1.0 on a 2 s file, edge RMS fell to ~3% of the source while the region around the peak kept ~92% - the envelope reaches unity only at peaktime. peaktype 0 = linear slopes, 1 = exponential (default per banner); range hard-enforced 0-1 (no undocumented 2/3 shapes here, unlike dovetail/curtail). Both parameters refuse breakpoints. Deterministic; stereo accepted.
musical_use: The one-gesture swell: turn any material into a rise-and-fall event - reversed-cymbal style builds, breath-shaped pads, or an emphatic mid-phrase bloom. peaktime early (5-20% in) approximates a soft attack with a long decay; peaktime late makes a long anticipatory crescendo that cuts off quickly. Exponential slopes (peaktype 1) read as natural loudness motion; linear (0) is more mechanical and keeps low-level detail audible longer. Where dovetail fades only the edges and leaves the middle untouched, swell reshapes the ENTIRE file into the arch - use dovetail to clean edges, swell to compose a gesture. For arbitrary multi-segment shapes use envel scaled (hand-drawn envelope) or envel create + impose.

peaktime.description: Time of the loudness peak. CDP-enforced 0.005 to indur-0.005 (input-dependent: '(0.005000 to 1.995000)' quoted on a 2 s file - no static max). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1'). Scalar only.

peaktype.description: Slope shape: 0 linear, 1 exponential (banner default). Hard-enforced 0-1 ('Parameter[2] Value (5.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)') - the dovetail family's undocumented shapes 2/3 do NOT exist here. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 3' - CDP's slot numbering). Scalar only.

examples.description: Classic reverse-swell build into a cut-off.
examples.expected_use: On a 2 s file: 1.8 s exponential crescendo, then a fast 0.2 s die-away. Duration unchanged.
Linear rise to 0.3 s then a long linear decay - percussive material becomes a pillowy event.

known_issues: peaktime's bounds are input-dependent (0.005 to indur-0.005); the refusal quotes the per-file range.
The whole file is re-enveloped - existing dynamics are multiplied under the arch, not replaced. Quiet sources stay proportionally quiet at the peak.
Both params scalar-only (breakpoints refused, parameters 1 and 3 in CDP's numbering).
Deterministic; duration static and exact; stereo accepted (2-channel output).
